parsed.explanation: Combined regime pairs nationwide passport-binary rules, entry refusal for document discrepancy with possible lifetime fraud ineligibility, federal facilities restriction, and documented severe immigration/prison custody abuse with a state layer that bars licence marker changes and minor care but, as of April 2026, has no restroom ban. Courts, injunctions, hate-crime enhancement and local ordinances provide real but contested remedies. Discovery can cause refusal, detention and birth-sex custody, but imprisonment is not highly likely and execution is not documented.

entry_documents.exposure: National binary passport rule stopped X/new mismatched markers Feb 2025; Supreme Court allowed it Nov 2025. Feb 2025 cable: refuse on document discrepancy/doubt and consider permanent fraud ineligibility for wilful misrepresentation. Passport confiscation/blocking reported.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid to expiry; ACLU suit and court challenges pending; limited waivers for fraud finding; several executive orders blocked/enjoined.
entry_documents.interaction: Document mismatch at entry can escalate to refusal, additional evidence demands, secondary screening and, if deemed wilful, lifetime-ineligibility consideration.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: National corrections bureau from 2026 adopted conversion-therapy model: hair cutting, hormone removal, psychiatric drugs; stopped reporting trans prisoner numbers. Immigration custody: trans men reported forced labour, beatings, solitary and severe sexual abuse.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Rescinded prison LGBTQ order is part of hostile policy; no documented operative remedy for custody abuse in dossier. Courts enjoin some orders generally.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Visa/entry detention or any arrest can lead to birth-sex placement, care denial and documented abuse, with consular outcome not documented.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: January 2025 order bars trans people from government-funded single-sex facilities matching identity. In this state/province, as of April 2026 no law restricts restrooms matching identity; Jan 2026 school/university bill passed Senate but is not law.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Two cities protect restroom use by ordinance; 2023 appellate injunction barred schools limiting trans student bathroom use during litigation; state bans do not apply here per map category.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Federal buildings/airports subject to national restriction while state public restrooms are not, so exposure varies by operator and journey stage.

care_services.exposure: State law, upheld Nov 2024, bans transition procedures including blockers/hormones for under-18 with phase-out. National orders target minor care and public funding; adult care availability not documented.
care_services.protection: Not documented for adult visitors. Adult hormone continuity, import or emergency care for visitors: Not documented.
care_services.interaction: Adult with minor: minor cannot obtain banned care in-state; adult medication continuity at borders/clinics is uncertain, not documented.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Executive order defines sex as binary at birth, removes gender-ideology materials, rescinds pronoun/name and prison policies. May 2026 counterterrorism strategy prioritises groups described as radically pro-transgender; DOJ directed to investigate/prosecute teachers facilitating social transition.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: 2020 Supreme Court employment ruling, national hate-crime statute, marriage recognition, and court injunctions/blocking of several orders remain documented counterweights.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Official threat-framing increases discretionary enforcement at borders, schools and facilities despite formal rights, making outcomes dependent on officer/agency and litigation status.

minors_guardians.exposure: Minor care banned; school must notify parents on name/pronoun request; trans athlete entry ban; proposed birth-certificate and school facility bill not law. Denial of care and school bathroom litigation documented historically.
minors_guardians.protection: Care ban was enjoined June 2023 before taking effect Feb 2024; some national orders enjoined. No documented visitor-specific school protection.
minors_guardians.interaction: Travelling minor faces care denial and document-based school/facility restriction risk; guardian faces investigation/funding threats framed nationally, though teacher-prosecution order is resident-facing.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: 2025 poll: 66% support assigned-sex on licences/passports. Airport screening described as invasive/outing risk. No documented pattern of traveller street violence in dossier.
street_violence_police_response.protection: State 2019 hate-crime law adds aggravating circumstance for gender-identity motivation; national hate-crime law covers gender identity. Enforcement frequency not documented.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Hostile public opinion plus discretionary policing raises confrontation risk, while hate-crime enhancement offers some recourse if prosecuted.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport suit, DMV marker-ban challenge, executive-order challenges and health-rule proposals unresolved; outcome and timing uncertain. No enforcement data for state hate-crime enhancement.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Functioning courts have issued injunctions/blocks, ACLU litigation, legal-aid FAQ, local ordinances and 22-state plus capital discrimination protections nationally.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Remedies exist but do not reliably prevent entry refusal, facility exclusion or custody harm before travel ends; protection is partial and contested.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar discretionary stops, document checks and ineffective immediate relief, but here courts have enjoined orders, litigation is active, and this state has no restroom ban, so above 0.35.

Similar secondary screening, refusal and administrative delay, but documented custody sexual abuse, conversion-therapy prison policy and lifetime fraud consideration make consequences more severe than 0.55.

Higher than 0.75 because detention is not merely brief/humiliating: passport binary rule, entry refusal, federal facility ban and severe custody abuse are documented, with remedies contested rather than reliable.

parsed.synthesis: Interaction is decisive: a document discrepancy at entry can trigger refusal or fraud consideration; any detention can move the traveller into birth-sex custody with documented abuse and care denial; federal facilities are restricted while state restrooms are not. Minors face a clear care ban. Working courts, injunctions, hate-crime enhancement and city ordinances prevent the regime matching routine-detention anchors at 0.35, but they do not neutralise the national hostile framework, yielding 0.44.
